heroHeadline: PMF Law Reaches Parliament as Zaidi Holds Firm on 'Final' Sept 30 Deadline; Oil Revenue Craters to $2.3B/Month
heroSubtitle: Iraq's disarmament standoff sharpened through August: PM Zaidi declared September 30 the 'fixed and final' date for both the US-led coalition withdrawal and militia weapons handover after meeting CENTCOM's Gen. Brad Cooper (Aug 12), while Badr's Mohammed Naji warned forced disarmament risks 'internal strife' (Aug 13–14) and the Iran-aligned 'Islamic Resistance in Iraq' briefly threatened retaliation over US-Saudi strikes before Badr mediation defused it (Aug 7). Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf made a high-profile Baghdad visit (Aug 19–21) as Iraq sought Hormuz transit relief with oil revenue collapsed from $6.8B (Feb) to $2.3B (Jun). By Aug 23, parliament's Security and Defense Committee finalized a draft PMF Authority Law that would make the PMF a permanent, multi-billion-dollar state institution — a move analysts warn contradicts the disarmament push. Iraq and Turkey signed a one-year Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline transit deal (Aug 1, 750K bpd capacity) to partially offset export losses.
